node.title: Creating .csv file with comma
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi Monks!

I need to send a .csv file through POST and one if the string in this .csv file has a "," comma. I've been trying to escape the comma as this,

... my $number = "100"; push @data, [ '1234565', "Prototype", '"Number in address is '.$number.'. Please, Please check your records."', ];

but when I look at the file it shows two double quotes instead of one as I expected.
1234565,Prototype,""Number in address is 100. Please, check your records.""

I was aiming for something like this to see if will accept the comma. 1234565,Prototype,"Number in address is 100. Please, check your records." Any suggestions?

Thanks for looking!
